title: Quick Smoke-Cold Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: A rich, crunchy, comforting Moroccan dish featuring mixed spice, smoke-cold, and anti-inflammatory-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: mixed spice
ingredients.notes: Moroccan blend, including cinnamon, ginger, and turmeric

instructions: Rinse the chicken thighs and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the mixed spice, smoked paprika, cumin, and coriander.
Rub the spice blend all over the chicken thighs, making sure they're evenly coated.
Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in the bottom of a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear the chicken thighs for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they're browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set it aside on a plate.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until they're softened and lightly browned.
Add the chopped garlic to the pot and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Stir in the chicken broth, dried apricots, and almonds.
Return the chicken thighs to the pot and simmer, covered, for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the flavors have melded together.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
